rules: Cap TS_STD/TS_ARGMAX/TS_RANK/TS_DELTA windows on a fundamental at ~63 days — 126/252-day windows on leverage, book_per_share, asset_turnover, and earnings_per_share caused 6 of this round's 20 rejects, all on coverage (0.824-0.882), even for asset_turnover which is normally coverage-safe at the level.

Changing only a window size (e.g. 21->63) on an already-tried skeleton doesn't decorrelate it — two such edits this round scored rho 0.993-0.994 against the original; vary an inner operator or which field fills a slot instead.

Don't spread two fundamental ranks built on the same underlying driver (roa vs roe both key off net income) — that pairing failed cheap_screen at |t| 0.96; keep rank spreads to fundamentals measuring genuinely different things (profitability vs leverage/turnover).

Favor more variations on value x quality products (a book/price-style ratio times a profitability rank) — this shape scored 8.954 this round, far above every other accept and above the quality-momentum and quality-leverage spreads that also cleared.

Avoid CS_ZSCORE(return-or-volume ratio) multiplied against a single fundamental rank — this combination scored |t| 0.02 and 0.59 in two attempts this round, well under the CS_RANK*CS_RANK product/spread shapes that were accepted.

Delta the raw fundamental before ranking it, not after — TS_DELTA(CS_RANK($roe), 21) scored |t| 0.26, far weaker than the accepted CS_RANK($roe) - CS_RANK(TS_MEAN($return, 63)) spread built from the same field.
Check within-run duplicates more carefully around $open/$high/$low extremum ratios sharing a window — 3 of this round's 20 rejects were exact repeats already proposed earlier in the same run.

A single swapped leaf (one OHLC field for another, or which field sits in numerator vs denominator) inside an otherwise-archived multi-term shape still shares 4-6 nodes and trips archive_subtree — vary an inner operator or restructure the term, not just the leaf.
